confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied context, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain and vary a lot by neighborhood (El Poblado versus Laureles or El Centro), and July is a high-demand school-holiday period in Colombia. Colombian peso exchange-rate movement adds uncertainty to all USD values. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Colombian and Latin American urban tourism pricing, benchmarked to Bogotá and other mid-sized Colombian cities with similar visitor demand. Medellín is priced slightly below Bogotá for dining and lodging, with a premium in the El Poblado tourist core. Cocktail and wine were estimated as roughly 3 times the draft beer price, consistent with local bar and restaurant pricing.
